concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading 5 distinct datasets. T014 lists 5 URLs, but 3 are empty strings (NOAA Global, NOAA USW00014833, NOAA USW00014895). Without valid URLs, the task cannot satisfy FR-001. The spec requires 'at least 5 distinct public... datasets'.

FR-005 mandates calculating VIF and N_eff in the regression model. T037a_impl (Linear Regression) does not include VIF/N_eff calculation in its description, relying on T037c. However, T037c is marked [X] (complete) while T037a_impl is [ ] (incomplete). If T037a_impl is implemented without T037c, FR-005 is violated. The task description for T037a_impl must explicitly include VIF/N_eff calculation or T037c must be a hard dependency listed in the task header.

FR-003 and Constitution Principle VII require generating 1,000 shuffled versions for *every* time series. T019a and T019b specify '1000 shuffled versions' but the tasks are marked [X] (complete) while the actual generation logic in T010 (metrics) depends on them. The circular dependency (T010 needs T019a/b, T019a/b needs T010 for metrics) creates a logical gap where the shuffling might not be executed if the metrics task fails, violating the 'must run even if metric calculation fails' constraint in T019a/b.

T014 lists URLs with empty strings: 'NOAA Global Summary (URL: )', 'NOAA Station USW00014833 (URL: )', 'NOAA Station USW00014895 (URL: )'. This is a formatting error in the task description that prevents execution. The URLs must be filled in or the task must reference a configuration file where they are defined.

FR-005 explicitly forbids using Max_ACF_Lag1 and spectral density as predictors. T037b implements the filtering logic, but T037a_runner (the execution task) lists T037b as a dependency. However, T037b is marked [ ] (incomplete) while T037a_runner is [ ] (incomplete). If T037a_runner is executed before T037b, the regression will include forbidden predictors, violating FR-005. The task dependency chain must be strictly enforced or T037b must be marked complete before T037a_runner can proceed.
